entities.name: PMID:25099007
observations: Introduces a tail-area-based FDR approach to distinguish barcoded from unbarcoded reads in noisy high-throughput DNA sequencing data.

entities.name: FDR barcode detection performance
observations: Proof-of-concept evaluation detected barcodes in 83% of reads at 89% precision; adding adjacent primer evidence yielded 99% sensitivity at 99% precision, with further improvement from paired-end analysis.
